definitions.explanation: The soft, fluffy feathers of birds, especially the fine underfeathers used as insulating material in bedding and clothing. Also refers to bird feathers in general.

examples.japanese: {羽毛|うもう}ぶとんは{軽|かる}くて{暖|あたた}かい。
examples.english: Down comforters are light and warm.

examples.japanese: この{羽毛|うもう}ジャケットは{真冬|まふゆ}でも{十分|じゅうぶん}{暖|あたた}かい。
examples.english: This down jacket is warm enough even in the middle of winter.

examples.japanese: {水鳥|みずどり}の{羽毛|うもう}は{水|みず}をはじく{性質|せいしつ}があるため、{高級|こうきゅう}な{寝具|しんぐ}の{素材|そざい}として{重宝|ちょうほう}されている。
examples.english: Waterfowl down has water-repelling properties, so it is valued as a material for high-quality bedding.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in compound words related to bedding and clothing products. {羽毛|うもう}ぶとん (down comforter) is by far the most frequent collocation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羽毛|うもう}ぶとん (down comforter/duvet)
- {羽毛|うもう}ジャケット (down jacket)
- {羽毛|うもう}を{使|つか}った (made with down)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {羽|はね}: feather, wing (general everyday word for individual feathers)
- ダウン: down (loanword, used interchangeably in product names like ダウンジャケット)
